title: fix(objectql,cloud-connection)!: a field patch reaches the owner's own fields only, at the fold and the install door; the install door refuses it with 422 (#28733)

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XDtHpahW3JW9RnV7EYAKycN)_

Fixes #28733

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #28730 (the owner-only rule is named there in one sentence; `skills/**` is not edited here)

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：对象扩展的字段显示补丁（`fieldPatches`）现在只作用于对象所有者自己声明的字段。注册表合并、市场安装口、`os validate` 三处答案一致：补丁指向别的扩展（或本扩展 `fields`）新增的字段时，合并不应用并在日志里记一次，安装口拒绝。安装口这条拒绝的状态码从 400 改为 422，和该入口其它请求体拒绝一致。
- **为什么改**：以前同一个补丁三处三种答案：合并时取决于两个扩展谁的 priority 高，安装口放行，`os validate` 拒绝。spec 的说明本来就写着「目标对象自己的字段」。
- **风险与回滚**：只影响补丁指向扩展新增字段的包；仓库内 `examples/**` 和 `packages/*/src` 中这样的包为 0。补丁指向所有者字段的行为不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `ownFieldNamesOf` / `applyFieldPatches` / `reportFieldPatchMisses`（合并只认所有者字段）；② `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 的 2e 步（改读所有者声明，422）；③ 新公开方法 `SchemaRegistry#getFieldPatchTarget`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-extension-field-patches.test.ts`，预期 11 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Ruling 1, the fold** (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`): `foldExtendersOntoDefinition` computes `ownFieldNamesOf(own contributor)` once, the record-spelled field names the `own` contributor declares. `mergeObjectDefinitions` passes it to `applyFieldPatches`, which skips any patch whose field is not one of them, whatever the priorities. `reportFieldPatchMisses` asks the same judge (`fieldPatchTargetMisses`) of `ownFieldsTarget(merged, ownFields)`, the owner's fields as merged so far, so what the fold names is exactly what it skipped, once per object/package/field/option, as before. With no `own` contributor there is nothing to judge against: nothing applies and nothing is named (the same "no opinion" edge `tenantPatchedDisplayKeys` has). The PM assumption holds: the `own` contributor lookup `tenantPatchedDisplayKeys` uses gives the field set.
- **Ruling 1, the install door** (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, step 2e): the target is now `registry.getFieldPatchTarget(name)`, the owner's declaration, instead of `registry.getObject(name)`, the resolved object carrying every extension's fields. A target the artifact delivers is still read off its body (already an owner declaration). New public `SchemaRegistry#getFieldPatchTarget(name)`: name-addressed like `getObject`, returns the `own` contributor's definition.
- **Ruling 1, `os validate`**: unchanged (it already judges declared `objects`).
- **Ruling 1, prose**: the `mergeObjectDefinitions` docblock and inline comment, the `applyFieldPatches` and `reportFieldPatchMisses` docblocks ("applies on the next read" now names an owner re-registering with the field), and `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` (table row, the "lower-priority extension" bullet replaced by an owner-only bullet, "does not declare").
- **Ruling 2** (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, prose only): the `guidance.actions` sentence now reads "the merge carries `fields`, `label`, `pluralLabel`, `description`, `validations` and `indexes`, and applies `fieldPatches`, and nothing else." No shape change; `check:generated` reports all 14 artifacts up to date.
- **Ruling 3, choice: the fold judges the record spelling only.** Measured what reaches `foldObjectExtendersOnto` in practice: a showcase boot (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, 115 objects) with a preload counting the `fields` spelling of every body at that method, then every by-name and `?layers=true` meta read: 230 bodies, all record-spelled (226 with no extender, 4 with one), 0 array-spelled. The merge itself reads the record spelling (`fields` is spread), so the fold now patches and judges that one spelling: an array-spelled body handed to the fold is not patched and the patch is named. No change in `metadata-core`'s judge, which keeps reading both spellings for the doors.
- **Ruling 4**: step 2e answers `UNRUNNABLE_REFUSAL_CODE` / `UNRUNNABLE_REFUSAL_STATUS` (422), as 1c'' and the door's other body refusals do. Code, message and `details.refusals` unchanged.
- **Comment the change made false, outside the file surface**: `packages/metadata-core/src/extension-field-patch-targets.ts`, the `fieldPatchTargetMisses` docblock said the target is "the registry's resolved object at the install door and in the fold". Now: the owner's declaration at the door, the owner's fields as merged in the fold. Comment only, no code.
- `.changeset/28733-field-patch-owner-fields-only.md`: **minor** + BREAKING banner on `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/spec` (kind `narrowed`), ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `@objectstack/metadata-core` moves a comment only and is not listed.
- **Migration count** (the PM assumption, measured): `git grep -c fieldPatches -- 'examples/**'` finds 0 files; under `packages/*/src` the key appears only in the implementing code and tests. No shipped package patches an extension-added field, so the narrowing refuses or skips nothing that exists today.

The previous test "applies after the additive merges: a patch reaches a field another extender adds at a lower priority" pinned the behaviour ruling 1 removes; it is replaced by the both-priorities test above, not deleted.

## Acceptance notes

- The miss message the fold and the door show for an extension-added field is `metadata-core`'s existing sentence ("names a field object X does not have … use the name of a field X declares, or declare a field of your own in `fields`"). Read against the owner's declaration it is accurate; it does not say that another extension adds the field. Left as is: the message is outside the file surface and its remedy already points at `fields`.
- The fold judges option patches against the owner-named field as merged (an extension that redeclares an owner field through `fields` replaces its options there), while the door and `os validate` read the owner's own options. This edge needs an extension that takes an owner field over through `fields`; not measured in any shipped package.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-object-extension-property-classes.test.ts:31` quotes the old `guidance.actions` sentence in a comment. Comment only, outside the file surface; not edited.

## Verification

- **Live probe, install-local, base vs head** (commands and full logs in the project files, `pm-orders/server/evidence/28733/`): `node probe.mjs REPO` boots `tsx packages/cli/bin/run-dev.js start -p 0 --artifact host.json` with a host object `host_account`, installs package A (adds `region`, priority 100) with `node packages/cli/bin/run.js package install ./dist/objectstack.json --runtime BASE`, POSTs package B (patches `region`) to `/api/v1/marketplace/install-local`, installs package C (patches `industry`), and reads `GET /api/v1/meta/object/host_account` after each.
  - base `706ac52d`: B → `HTTP 200`, served `region.label = "Territory"`; C → served `industry.label = "Sector"`.
  - head: B → `HTTP 422 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `details.refusals` = `["objectExtensions[0].fieldPatches.region"]`, served `region.label = "Region"`; C → installs, served `industry.label = "Sector"`.
- **Ruling 3 measurement**: `fold-spelling-preload.mjs` + `sweep-meta.mjs` in the same folder; reading `{"record|plain":226,"record|extended":4}`, no `array` key.
- **Gates**: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `60428213`: 107 derived, 107 run, every exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 107 derived, 107 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date.
- **Dogfood battery** (narrowing arm): head `60428213`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0` (held 22m43s); Test Files 376 passed, 3 skipped (379); Tests 3067 passed, 28 skipped (3095); 0 failed.
- **Main after the gates**: `origin/main` moved 13 commits after the `60428213` merge; the only overlap is a non-adjacent hunk in `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` (#28746, `listedIdentity`); `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main` exits 0. #28574 has not landed.
